name: Neil Industries Limited
about: Neil Industries Limited operates as a non-banking finance company primarily in India. The company provides loans for business or capacity expansion, purchase of equipment and machinery, term loans against property, and purchase of commercial property; working capital loans; and term loans against property. It also offers asset financing, promoter funding, stressed assets funding, and margin financing; and investment, project financing, project development, management and implementation, and asset management services. In addition, the company provides insurance services. Neil Industries Limited was incorporated in 1983 and is based in Kanpur, India.
